expectations.text: Raises vendor acquisition and continuity risk as a first-order selection criterion, not an afterthought
expectations.evidence: The transcript never directly names the risk that a vendor gets acquired, shuts down or runs out of money, and it never mentions vendor stability or funding. It does cover related mitigations. It treats proprietary config as lock-in ('Proprietary config is lock-in... lets you switch vendors later'). It lists 'Exit terms' as item 8: 'whether you own the generated code, whether the license lets you keep it and stop paying, and whether you can eject and maintain it yourself'.
